key_information_units.information: Headline financial performance showing revenue of EUR 118.7 million (-0.8%), adjusted EBITDA of EUR 56.5 million (+6%), profit of EUR 22.5 million (+17%), and investments of EUR 33.2 million (-14%), with improved equity position and reduced net debt.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Section 5.1 Key performance indicators table and surrounding text; Consolidated Financial Statements

key_information_units.information: Passenger business growth with 8.3 million passengers (+1.0% YoY), dominated by Tallinn-Helsinki route (+1% passengers), and cruise tourism recovery featuring 190 thousand cruise passengers (+25%) and 118 calls (+18), offset by Tallinn-Stockholm decline.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Sections 5.4 Market overview: passengers and 5.6.1 Number of passengers

key_information_units.information: Cargo volume recovery to 13.8 million tonnes (+5.1% YoY) driven by liquid bulk surge (+47%, led by ligroin and gasoline), transit goods growth (+75%), and dry bulk increase, partially offset by ro-ro and container declines.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Sections 5.5 Market overview: cargo and 5.6.2 Cargo volume

key_information_units.information: Major strategic infrastructure investments including completion of multifunctional quay at Paldiski South Harbour, Muuga Harbour quay reinforcement for large vessels, and ongoing design work for Old City Harbour Terminal A and shore power capacity.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Section 5.10 Investments and development prospects

key_information_units.information: Dividend distribution of EUR 19.199 million (EUR 0.073 per share) representing 100% of prior year profit, aligned with policy, accompanied by share price appreciation to EUR 1.296 (+22.7%).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Sections 5.11 Dividends and 5.12 Share and shareholders

key_information_units.information: Adverse impact of Russia-Ukraine war reducing liquid bulk volumes and eliminating St. Petersburg cruise calls, partially mitigated by winter cruise season extension, regional marketing, and economic recovery in Estonia and Nordic partners.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Sections 5.2 Economic environment and 5.3 Impact of Russia-Ukraine war

key_information_units.information: Icebreaker Botnica operated at reduced utilization rate (49%) with lower charter revenue, but participated in international rescue operations for cargo ship MV Thamesborg in Canadian Arctic waters.

Environmental sustainability progress including 77% renewable energy usage in operations, GHG emissions reduction of 11% YoY to 19,261 tonnes CO2e, and initiatives for shore power and waste circularity at Old City Harbour.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Section 3 Environment and CEO letter (Section 1.4)
